verdict.rationale: Phoenix's first-party docs describe Prompt Management for versioning, storing and deploying prompts, plus client SDKs that keep prompts in sync across applications and environments. That implies a prompt change can reach production by pulling the prompt rather than redeploying code. missing for 10: explicit documentation of environment/production tags or promotion and rollback workflow, an explicit statement that prompt changes go live without a code deploy, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code

citations.quote: Prompt Management — Version, store, and deploy prompts
Prompt Management: Create, store, change, and deploy the prompts that your application sends to LLMs.
You can version prompts, test prompt variants across datasets, and replay calls to see how changes affect outputs before rolling them out.
Phoenix offers client SDKs to keep your prompts in sync across different applications and environments.
